package.name: Upload
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Upload an explicitly selected file after destination approval.

exports.description: Host-only explicit file choice and plaintext cloud-upload consent; no peer receive endpoint. Linux requires zenity and a desktop file portal.

choose.description: Choose one file, disclose public-link visibility and request explicit transient upload approval. No persisted file access grant.

pages.changes: Accepting lets the application install and run this extension; it grants no extra rights over your files, devices or data.

pages.title: What this extension does
pages.explains: Upload sends one file you explicitly choose to a cloud destination you configure, only after the application asks and you approve each upload. It stores an API key for that destination in the application's credential store.
pages.changes: After installing, an 'Upload file…' action appears. Choosing it can send the selected file to a third-party service where it may be publicly visible through a link. The application asks before every upload; nothing is sent automatically.
